items.title: 52043_Herman Autrey oral history interview
items.q: I had spread it how he got around, and listened to him... there's never been but one Louie Armstrong.

ctx.x: And pretty soon there, you know, I had spread it how he got around, and listened to him, and other guys like him, and still there's never been but one Louie Armstrong. Never will be.
Well, how did you -- you first heard him on a record, I guess, didn't you?
